register: du (informal singular, lowercase, as premium German-language health apps use). Straight register: calm, plain, patient-leaflet German (gesundheitsinformation.de / BZgA terms). Wry register: dry, warm humour. No exclamation marks. German quotation marks „…“.
gender: Gender-neutral constructions wherever possible (du addresses the user directly, German does not mark the user's gender there). Clinicians: 'Ärztin oder Arzt' in running text as gesundheitsinformation.de does; compounds use 'Arzt-' (Arzttermin, Arztnotizen). No gender colon/asterisk.

glossary.surge: Welle (f., Pl. Wellen): 'eine Welle', '3 Wellen', 'Ich habe gerade eine Welle'
glossary.night sweat: Nachtschweiß / nächtliches Schwitzen; counted: nächtlicher Schweißausbruch (Pl. nächtliche Schweißausbrüche)
glossary.clinician: Ärztin oder Arzt (running text); Arzt- in compounds (Arzttermin, Arztnotizen)
glossary.Apple Health: Apple Health; the app itself: Health-App
